reserveReview.rationale: D-1/D-4/D-5: Ethereum block 26214950 (2026-10-17T21:25:35Z), independently observed 2026-10-17T21:32:25Z, gives 113,058,118.240939048310629383 minted DOLA, 71,292,840.879323003036446379 FiRM debt and 38,462,480.393859181931889876 idle DOLA across all 49 markets. Fed per-market supplies sum exactly to globalSupply 109,754,203.482632377452169839; debt plus idle exceeds that issuance by 1,117.790549807516166416. Under existing symmetric-netting policy, exclude the same idle own-token amount from claims and the denominator, leaving 74,595,637.847079866378739507 face-value net claims. Idle DOLA receives no external reserve credit. The separate issuer Frontier bad-debt checkpoint contributes 2,765,404.930738723 DOLA; the remaining 537,392.03701814 is unresolved, not non-FiRM or measured bad debt. The checkpoint clocks differ and the shares describe a reviewed debt-weighted claim map, not independent collateral TVL or a complete net-solvency attestation. Invalid-feed yv-USR debt 88.012207824144463745 and its idle inventory are included from direct contract reads. Both old/new PSM reserve observations are zero, so no USDS backing is inferred (D-6). LP collateral and circular DOLA/sDOLA constituents remain undecomposed.
